translations.english: It was filled with elephants in rut breathing heavily, which was like a tempestuous wind around, that echoed by the blowing of conchs of the early morning and filled with the sounds of drums and trumpets.
translations.hindi: वह्‌ मतवाले गजेन्द्रं के श्वास के वायु से पूर्ण रहता था तथा शङ्क और नगाड़ों के शब्दों से प्रतिध्वनित हुआ करता था
